verdict.rationale: OpenAI's developer platform exposes a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown-formatted docs pages explicitly designed for agent consumption, which an agent built with the Agents SDK could be pointed at directly. missing for 10: no first-party doc or example showing the Agents SDK itself fetching/parsing llms.txt as a built-in feature, and no independent hands-on report confirming an agent successfully using it end-to-end.
